recorded_acquisition.verification: The exact bounded VCF was retrieved from this protocol's source URL and independently reacquired with pysam 0.24.1. Both copies had this checksum. The GRCh38 source collection is documented by IGSR; the chr2 header length was checked. This contract binds those recorded bytes, not arbitrary caller-provided checksums or missing metadata in other files.

sample_selection: All sample columns at the exact allele; one source sample represents one donor in this release.
quality_policy: Count complete diploid GT calls at a source PASS or dot record. Preserve dot as unfiltered; do not infer a PASS, DP or GQ check. Exclude missing, partial, non-diploid or sample-filtered calls. Count original ALT indexes without splitting the record.
interpretation: Separate BCL11A/SpCas9 nuclease known-case count of the supplied genotypes. Source verification distinguishes recorded or direct public acquisition from unverified local inputs; expected protocol provenance alone does not establish a file's source. No callable whole-target DNA, available specimen, editing outcome or HBG base-editor validation is established. Keep individual source rows and carrier memberships protected locally.
